public_sources.bound_semantics: RocksDB DeleteRange represents deletion of an ordered key range as a single range tombstone rather than one point tombstone per key.
A range deletion tombstone carries start/end bounds and a sequence number; keys in the covered range at older sequence numbers are treated as deleted.
A Bloom filter has one-sided error: a positive containment result may be false, while a negative result is definitive for a correctly implemented filter.

chat_native_reduction.range_mapping: A durable finalized-through epoch marker compactly covers every origin epoch <= the marker, analogous to one ordered range tombstone replacing many point tombstones.
chat_native_reduction.open_epoch_rule: Only epochs newer than finalized-through retain exact semantic-key sets.
chat_native_reduction.bloom_control: A correct standard Bloom filter has no false negatives, so the frozen false-negative trace is a fatal implementation-corruption control rather than an expected operating case. Its permitted false positives still make it unsuitable for exact useful parity because fresh valid keys can be rejected.
